objective: A frozen exploratory census, exact: tori of the snub square 3.3.4.3.4 and snub hexagonal 3.3.3.3.6 (Conway snub of the square and triangular tori), the elongated triangular 3.3.3.4.4 tiling and their three duals (Cairo, floret and prismatic pentagonal), of every shape to a size cap: whether a contact persists exactly when it has a flip, and whether any keeps every contact persistent.
title: The flip rule on the snub and elongated tilings and their duals: a census
